title: ArgoCD LoopRuntime wrapper values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on ArgoCD bootstrap config drift. Protects: B17 (notifications.notifiers vs deprecated services key), T-05 (controller.replicas=3 for L3+ scale), fix-all-platform-issues T3.1 (duplicate ARGOCD_CONTROLLER_REPLICAS env var). Catches typos that silently break notifications + sync.

tag.description: ArgoCD image tag, SemVer with optional 'v' prefix (e.g., 'v2.13.3'). Avoid 'latest' — drill DOCR rejects (Bug #16).

runAsNonRoot.description: INF-G08 invariant: ArgoCD server MUST run as non-root.

nodePortHttp.description: NodePort range per K8s default (30000-32767). Outside range = silent rejection by K8s.

additionalLabels.description: Prometheus operator needs release label to discover. Without it, scraping silently fails.

replicas.description: T-05: 3 replicas with sharding distributes Applications by hash. Single controller saturates at L3+ (100+ Apps). >10 = diminishing returns + sharding stability concerns.

notifications.description: B17 protection: argo-cd chart v7.x uses 'notifiers' key (NOT 'services' — silently ignored). Schema enforces correct key name.

notifiers.description: B17 correct key. argo-cd v7.x silently ignores 'services'. Each subkey is service.<type>.<name> mapping to YAML config.
